reviewed_scope: The full frozen manuscript packet for the tapered quantile regression method, including the main text, appendix proofs, and the simulation supplement.
overall_assessment: The manuscript is technically careful and the counterexample on naive variance estimation is honestly reported. The main weakness is the heavy-tailed error gap, which the authors disclose but do not bound.
strengths: The proof ledger separates assumptions from derived statements cleanly.
The preliminary simulation protocol is prespecified and matches the executed analyses.

prioritized_issues.issue: The statement of Theorem 2 does not say whether the quantile index is held fixed or allowed to drift with sample size, which changes how the taper condition should be read.
prioritized_issues.scientific_consequence: Readers may apply the normality result to drifting quantile sequences where the proof does not establish it.
evidence_basis: The proof in Section 4 fixes the quantile index before applying the Lindeberg argument.
The theorem statement omits any quantifier over the quantile index.
prioritized_issues.requested_resolution: Add an explicit fixed-index quantifier to the theorem statement or justify the drifting-index reading.

prioritized_issues.issue: The degrees-of-freedom parameter for the Student-t errors in Setting S2 appears only in the supplement, not in the main text, so the main-text description is not independently reproducible.
prioritized_issues.scientific_consequence: A reader working only from the main text could rerun Setting S2 with the wrong error law and misread the coverage results.
evidence_basis: The main text names the error family without the degrees-of-freedom value.
The supplement table lists five degrees of freedom.
prioritized_issues.requested_resolution: State the degrees-of-freedom value in the main text where Setting S2 is introduced.

sources_consulted: one bibliographic database for statistics journals
access_limits: No access to paywalled conference proceedings.
Search limited to English-language sources indexed before 2026-08-01.
novelty_search_boundary.conclusion: Within the stated search boundary, no prior work combines this exact taper sequence with a uniform consistency and bootstrap-validity account; the novelty assessment is bounded by the access limits above.

evidence_that_would_change_assessment: A prior publication using the same taper sequence with an equivalent uniform consistency result.
A simulation showing the bootstrap coverage claim fails at interior quantiles under the stated conditions.
